title: The Portable Madrasa: Print, Publics, and the Authority of the Deobandi Ulama
note: Brannon D. Ingram's peer-reviewed study of mass-printed Deobandi primers, including works by Ashraf Ali Thanwi, their readership, and religious authority.
whyItMatters: Places Thanwi's printed works within the Deobandi school's efforts to teach a wider lay reading public.
